name: Hetzner
receives: The server that runs the platform and holds its database: all accounts, records and evidence files.

name: Cloudflare
receives: All web traffic between your browser and the platform, including your IP address and the pages, records and files you send and receive. Cloudflare can read this traffic as it passes.
where: Cloudflare's data centres around the world, usually the one nearest to you

name: Resend
receives: The emails the platform sends, with the recipient's email address.
